item.title: Plasma Tunnels Reveal How Dying Satellites Fall to Earth
item.description:
📝 AerospaceNews Plasma Tunnels Reveal How Dying Satellites Really Fall to Earth Aluminum ash from satellites’ reentry may alter the atmosphereTereza Pultarova22 Jul 20266 min readTereza Pultarova is a London-based journalist specializing in aerospace and defense technologies. Researchers in Germany are simulating in the lab a satellite’s reentry into the atmosphere—revealing new dangers posed by many more reentries to come from today’s growing fleets of satellite constellations.
🔗 Read more: https://spectrum.ieee.org/space-debris-atmosphere-burn-up
